Software Requirements Specification
System is allowing to cancel Buyer Order GDN after Sales Invoice is created
Document # 362567
Version 1.0 ●30 Apr 2026
Contents
Section 1: Overview 3
Purpose. 3
Business Requirement 3
Scope 3
Section2. Solution 4
Functional Requirements 4

# Section 1: Overview

# Business Requirement
The user has cancelled the Buyer Order Dispatch transaction after creating the Sales Invoice, due to which the stock is showing incorrectly in the system. We need to implement a restriction so that once a Sales Invoice has been created, the Buyer Order Dispatch transaction cannot be cancelled.

# Scope
Section2. Solution

# Functional Requirements:
Once a Sales Invoice has been created against a Buyer Order Dispatch (GDN), the system should not allow cancellation of the Buyer Order Dispatch, If the Sales Invoice has been confirmed or Posted status, Else Cancel status can be Allowed.
Additionally, when the user attempts to cancel the GDN, the system should display an alert message listing the respective Sales Invoice(s) created against that transaction.

### Proposed System Restriction Logic:
• Validation Trigger Point:
• At the time of Buyer Order Dispatch (GDN) Cancellation
• Validation Condition:
• Check if any Sales Invoice exists against the selected GDN
• Restriction Rule:
• If Sales Invoice exists (even if cancelled) → Block cancellation
• If no Sales Invoice exists → Allow cancellation

### Error Message (User-Friendly):
"Cancellation not allowed: Sales Invoice(Invoice Number) has already been created against this Buyer Order Dispatch.
Attached Screen Shot with the Problem:
• Stock Overview Report
• GDI
• GDN
• Sales ASN
• Sales Invoice
• Sales Invoice : After the cancelled GDN also visible.
